INCOME TAX ACT 1967

INCOME TAX (PRESCRIBED FEES UNDER SCHEDULE 5 TO THE ACT) RULES 2020

IN exercise of the powers conferred by paragraph 15 4(1)(b) of the
Income Tax Act 1967 [Act 53], the Minister makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Income Tax ( Prescribed Fees under
Schedule 5 to the Act) Rules 2020.

(2) These Rules come into operation on 25 September 2020.

Prescribed fees
2. For the purpose of the payment of the fees under Schedule 5 to the Act,
the prescribed fees shall be as specified in the Schedule.

Revocation
3. The Income Tax ( Prescribed Fees Under Schedule 5 To The Act ) Rules 1998
[P.U. (A) 497/1998] are revoked.
